rows.text: returns -1 when `ecx` is above 3 (signed); otherwise takes the pointer at `022C6EC0` + `ecx`*8 when `r8d` is 0, or at `022C6EE8` + `ecx`*8 when it is non-zero, returns -1 when the first byte it points at is 0, and otherwise returns the dword at that pointer + `edx`*8 + 8 (`edx` sign-extended)
